Posting a till sale of 100.5 (the till exports amounts without the trailing
zero) is refused as unbalanced, although the debit and the credit are the
same amount:

    post(ledger, Entry("2026-04-02", "till", (("cash", "debit", "100.5"),
                                              ("sales", "credit", "100.50"))))
